curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: adopt reading pictures and textsfor enjoyment and information.

interactions.prompt: A picture shows dark clouds and a child holding an umbrella. What information does it give?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Pictures can give useful information.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the clouds and umbrella.

interactions.prompt: Read: Toto the calf skips happily in the field. Which part makes the scene enjoyable?
interactions.feedback: Correct! The playful action makes the text fun to imagine.
interactions.retryHint: Choose what happens in the sentence.

interactions.prompt: A sign reads: WASH YOUR HANDS. What information do you get?
interactions.feedback: Great! Reading gives information that keeps us healthy.
interactions.retryHint: Think about why people wash their hands.

interactions.prompt: Read: Bees visit flowers and carry pollen. What did you learn?
interactions.feedback: Well done! You found information in the text.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the idea stated in the sentence.

interactions.prompt: You want to know when the school trip begins. What should you read?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Choose a text that gives the information you need.
interactions.retryHint: Which text would show a time or date?

interactions.prompt: Which choice shows a good reading habit?
choices: Enjoy stories and use texts to learn
interactions.answer: Enjoy stories and use texts to learn
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You use pictures and texts for both enjoyment and information.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the habit that makes reading useful and fun.
